query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_WAFER VALUES(:wafer_seq, :lot_seq, :wafer_id, :tester, :probe_card, :operator, :probe_cnt, :tested_die, TO_DATE(:start_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), :wafer_cat, :loss_die, :isp_initem, :visual_item, :isp_outitem, :isp_incmt , :visual_cmt, :isp_outcmt, :fvi_flag)
SELECT * FROM TQP_LOT L,TQP_WAFER W WHERE L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq
SELECT * FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lotseq
SELECT * FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq
SELECT WAFER_SEQ, TESTED_DIE, START_TIME, END_TIME FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND TRIM(UPPER(WAFER_ID)) = TRIM(UPPER(:wafer_id)) AND PROBE_CNT = 0
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET PROBE_CNT= PROBE_CNT + 1 WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND TRIM(UPPER(WAFER_ID)) = TRIM(UPPER(:wafer_id))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT WAFER_ID )FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq
SELECT START_TIME FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq ORDER BY START_TIME
SELECT END_TIME FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq ORDER BY END_TIME DESC
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET LOSS_DIE = :loss_die WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq
SELECT WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND LOT_SEQ = (SELECT LOT_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT WHERE TESTAREA = 'MULTIPROBE' AND PRODUCT = :product AND LOT_ID = :lot_id)
SELECT PROGRAM FROM TQP_LOT WHERE LOT_SEQ = (SELECT LOT_SEQ FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq)
SELECT LOT_SEQ FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND START_TIME = :start_time AND END_TIME = :end_time
SELECT TESTED_DIE FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND TRIM(UPPER(WAFER_ID)) = TRIM(UPPER(:wafer_id)) AND PROBE_CNT = 0
SELECT WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND TRIM(UPPER(WAFER_ID)) = TRIM(UPPER(:wafer_id)) AND PROBE_CNT = :probe_cnt
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET TESTED_DIE = :test_die WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq

SELECT L.LOT_ID || '-' || W.WAFER_ID AS WAFER_ID,W.WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT L,TQP_WAFER W WHERE L.LOT_SEQ IN ( ?? ) AND W.PROBE_CNT IN (??) AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ ORDER BY L.LOT_ID || '-' || W.WAFER_ID
DELETE FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET PROBE_CNT=:probe_cnt WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq

SELECT L.LOT_ID || '-' || W.WAFER_ID AS WAFER_ID,W.WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT L,TQP_WAFER W WHERE L.LOT_SEQ IN ( ?? ) AND W.PROBE_CNT=:probecnt AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ ORDER BY L.LOT_ID || '-' || W.WAFER_ID

select ??,WAFER_SEQ from ( select a.customer, a.facility, a.testarea, a.product, a.program, a.lot_seq, a.lot_id, b.wafer_seq, b.wafer_id, b.start_time, b.end_time, b.tester, b.operator, b.probe_cnt, b.probe_card from ( select a.customer, a.facility, a.testarea, a.product, a.program, b.lot_seq, b.lot_id from ( select customer_id customer, facility, testarea, a.product, program from TQP_PRODUCT a, TQP_PROGRAM b where b.testarea in ('INLINE','PCM','PARAMETRIC') and a.product=b.product ) a, TQP_LOT b where end_time between TO_DATE(:stime,'YYYY-MM-DD') and TO_DATE(:etime,'YYYY-MM-DD') and a.PRODUCT=b.PRODUCT and a.testarea=b.testarea and a.program=b.program ) a, TQP_WAFER b where end_time between TO_DATE(:stime,'YYYY-MM-DD') and TO_DATE(:etime,'YYYY-MM-DD') and a.lot_seq=b.lot_seq order by customer, facility, testarea, product, program, lot_id, wafer_id )

SELECT LW.PROGRAM,LW.LOT_ID,LW.WAFER_ID,SP.ITEM,S1.SITE AS SITE1,S2.SITE AS SITE2,S3.SITE AS SITE3,S4.SITE AS SITE4, S5.SITE AS SITE5,M.MINV,M.MAXV,M.AVGV,M.STDV,SP.LSL,' ' AS VALUEPOS,SP.USL,SP.UNIT FROM (SELECT PROGRAM ,LOT_ID ,WAFER_ID ,WAFER_SEQ FROM BUMPFA.TQP_LOT L,BUMPFA.TQP_WAFER W WHERE TESTAREA='PARAMETRIC' AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ) LW, (SELECT PROGRAM ,ITEM ,DECODE(LOWER_LIMIT,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,LOWER_LIMIT) as LSL ,DECODE(UPPER_LIMIT,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,UPPER_LIMIT) as USL ,UNIT FROM BUMPFA.TQP_PARASPEC WHERE TESTAREA='PARAMETRIC' AND PROGRAM =:program AND ITEM=:item) SP, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ, MIN("??") AS MINV,MAX("??") AS MAXV,TRUNC(AVG("??"),4) AS AVGV,TRUNC(STDDEV("??"),4) AS STDV FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? GROUP BY WAFER_SEQ) M, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=1) S1, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=2) S2, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=3) S3, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=4) S4, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=5) S5 WHERE LW.WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq AND LW.PROGRAM = SP.PROGRAM AND LW.WAFER_SEQ = M.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S1.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S2.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S3.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S4.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S5.WAFER_SEQ

SELECT LW.PROGRAM,LW.LOT_ID,LW.WAFER_ID,SP.ITEM,S1.SITE AS SITE1,S2.SITE AS SITE2,S3.SITE AS SITE3,S4.SITE AS SITE4, S5.SITE AS SITE5,M.MINV,M.MAXV,M.AVGV,M.STDV,SP.LSL,' ' AS VALUEPOS,SP.USL,SP.UNIT FROM (SELECT PROGRAM ,LOT_ID ,WAFER_ID ,WAFER_SEQ FROM BUMPFA.TQP_LOT L,BUMPFA.TQP_WAFER W WHERE TESTAREA='PARAMETRIC' AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ) LW, (SELECT PROGRAM ,ITEM ,DECODE(LOWER_LIMIT,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,LOWER_LIMIT) as LSL ,DECODE(UPPER_LIMIT,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,UPPER_LIMIT) as USL ,UNIT FROM BUMPFA.TQP_PARASPEC WHERE TESTAREA='PARAMETRIC' AND PROGRAM =:program AND ITEM=:item) SP, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ, MIN("??") AS MINV,MAX("??") AS MAXV,TRUNC(AVG("??"),4) AS AVGV,TRUNC(STDDEV("??"),4) AS STDV FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? GROUP BY WAFER_SEQ) M, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=1) S1, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=4) S2, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=5) S3, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=6) S4, (SELECT WAFER_SEQ,"??" AS SITE FROM BUMPFA.T_PCM_?? WHERE DIEID=9) S5 WHERE LW.WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq AND LW.PROGRAM = SP.PROGRAM AND LW.WAFER_SEQ = M.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S1.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S2.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S3.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S4.WAFER_SEQ AND M.WAFER_SEQ = S5.WAFER_SEQ
SELECT SITE_CNT FROM TQP_PROGRAM WHERE PRODUCT=:product AND PROGRAM=:program

INSERT INTO TQP_WAFER SELECT WAFER_SEQ.NEXTVAL AS WAFER_SEQ , :lot_seq AS LOT_SEQ, WAFER_ID, TESTER, PROBE_CARD, OPERATOR, 0, TESTED_DIE, TO_DATE(:start_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , WAFER_CAT, :loss_die AS LOSS_DIE, ISP_INITEM, VISUAL_ITEM, ISP_OUTITEM, ISP_INCMT, VISUAL_CMT, ISP_OUTCMT, FVI_FLAG, MAP_PRODUCT FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :pre_wafer_seq
SELECT WAFER_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL

-- Create Date : 2015-04-16 10:45:33 INSERT INTO TQP_WAFER( WAFER_SEQ ,FACTORY ,LOT_SEQ ,WAFER_ID ,PROBE_CNT ,START_TIME ,END_TIME) VALUES(
WAFER_SEQ.NEXTVAL ,:factory ,:lot_seq ,:wafer_id ,0 ,SYSDATE ,SYSDATE)
-- Create Date : 2015-04-15 22:00:33 SELECT * FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE 1=1 AND LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND PROBE_CNT = :probe_cnt

-- Create Date : 2019-06-06 20:13:21 SELECT T1.LOT_SEQ, T1.LOT_ID, T1.LOT_TYPE, T2.WAFER_SEQ, T2.WAFER_ID, T1.TEST_AREA, T1.DEVICE_ALIAS, T1.PROGRAM, T2.PROGRAM_REV, T2.PROBE_CNT FROM TQP_LOT T1, TQP_WAFER T2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACTORY AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T2.END_TIME >= TO_DATE (:dtstart,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND T2.END_TIME < TO_DATE (:dtend,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND T1.TEST_AREA = :testarea AND T1.DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND T1.PROGRAM = :program AND T1.LOT_SEQ IN (??) ORDER BY T2.WAFER_SEQ

MERGE INTO TQP_WAFER USING DUAL ON ( FACTORY = :FACTORY AND LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ AND WAFER_SEQ = :WAFER_SEQ AND PROBE_CNT = :PROBE_CNT ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET LOAD_TIME = SYSDATE, TESTER = :TESTER, PROBER = :PROBER, PROBE_CARD = :PROBE_CARD, OPERATOR = :OPERATOR, PROGRAM = :PROGRAM, PROGRAM_REV = :PROREV, START_QTY = :START_QTY, VENDOR_ID = :VENDOR_ID, MAX_X = :MAX_X, MAX_Y = :MAX_Y, WAF_FLAT = :WAF_FLAT, COMMENTS = :COMMENTS, SCRIBE_LOT = :SCRIBE_LOT, TEMP = :TEMP, OVERDRIVE = :OVERDRIVE, PGMPATH = :PGMPATH, DATA_SOURCE = :DATA_SOURCE, MAXSITE = :MAXSITE, TFVERSION = :TFVERSION, PROBECARD_TOUCHDOWNS = :PROBECARD_TOUCHDOWNS, SMSFAMILY_NAME = :SMSFAMILY_NAME, NUM_DIE = :NUM_DIE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( FACTORY, WAFER_SEQ, LOT_SEQ, WAFER_ID, PROBE_CNT, START_TIME, END_TIME, LOAD_TIME, TESTER, PROBER, PROBE_CARD, OPERATOR, PROGRAM, PROGRAM_REV, START_QTY, VENDOR_ID, MAX_X, MAX_Y, WAF_FLAT, COMMENTS, SCRIBE_LOT, TEMP, OVERDRIVE, PGMPATH, DATA_SOURCE, MAXSITE, TFVERSION, PROBECARD_TOUCHDOWNS, SMSFAMILY_NAME, NUM_DIE ) VALUES ( :FACTORY, :WAFER_SEQ, :LOT_SEQ, :WAFER_ID, :PROBE_CNT, TO_DATE(:START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(:END_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), SYSDATE, :TESTER, :PROBER, :PROBE_CARD, :OPERATOR, :PROGRAM, :PROREV, :START_QTY, :VENDOR_ID, :MAX_X, :MAX_Y, :WAF_FLAT, :COMMENTS, :SCRIBE_LOT, :TEMP, :OVERDRIVE, :PGMPATH, :DATA_SOURCE, :MAXSITE, :TFVERSION, :PROBECARD_TOUCHDOWNS, :SMSFAMILY_NAME, :NUM_DIE )

-- Create Date : 2019-07-12 13:48:35 SELECT WAFER_SEQ, PROBE_CNT FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY = :FACTORY AND LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ AND WAFER_ID = :WAFER_ID AND START_TIME = TO_DATE(:START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
-- Create Date : 2019-07-12 14:13:07 UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET PROBE_CNT = PROBE_CNT + 1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY = :FACTORY AND LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ AND WAFER_ID = :WAFER_ID
DELETE FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY = :FACTORY AND LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ AND WAFER_ID = :WAFER_ID

-- Create Date : 2019-07-22 16:25:03 SELECT 'DB' CUSTOMER, A.FACTORY FACILITY, A.DEVICE PRODUCT, TEST_AREA TESTAREA, A.PROGRAM, A.LOT_ID MOTHER_LOT_ID, A.DEVICE_ALIAS, A.LOT_ID, A.LOT_SEQ, B.WAFER_ID, B.WAFER_SEQ, B.TESTER, B.PROBE_CARD, B.OPERATOR, B.PROBE_CNT, C.NETDIE, B.START_TIME, B.END_TIME, 0 WAFER_CAT, 0 GEC, 0 YIELD FROM TQP_LOT A, TQP_WAFER B, TQP_MAPDEF C WHERE A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND A.FACTORY = C.FACTORY(+) AND A.DEVICE_ALIAS = C.MAPID(+) AND A.LOT_SEQ = :lotseq AND B.WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq
SELECT WAFER_SEQ, PROBE_CNT FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY = :FACTORY AND LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ AND WAFER_ID = :WAFER_ID

-- Create Date : 2019-08-01 10:32:49 SELECT DISTINCT DECODE(T3.PRODUCT, NULL, T1.DEVICE_ALIAS, T3.PRODUCT) AS PRODUCT, T1.LOT_ID, REGEXP_SUBSTR(T2.WAFER_ID, '[^-]+', REGEXP_INSTR(T2.WAFER_ID, '-')) AS WAFER_ID FROM TQP_LOT T1, TQP_WAFER T2, TQP_PRODUCT T3 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACTORY AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T1.FACTORY = T3.FACTORY(+) AND T1.DEVICE_ALIAS = T3.PRODUCT(+) AND T1.FACTORY = :factory AND T1.LOT_ID = :lotid AND T1.TEST_AREA NOT IN ('PARAMETRIC') AND T2.PROBE_CNT = 0 ORDER BY WAFER_ID

-- Create Date : 2019-08-01 10:34:50 SELECT T1.LOT_ID, T1.TEST_AREA, T3.PRODUCT, T3.MAPID, T2.WAFER_ID, T1.PROGRAM, T2.PROGRAM_REV, T2.WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT T1, TQP_WAFER T2, TQP_PRODUCT T3 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACTORY AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T1.FACTORY = T3.FACTORY AND T1.DEVICE_ALIAS = T3.PRODUCT AND T1.FACTORY = :factory AND T1.LOT_ID = :lotid AND REGEXP_SUBSTR(T2.WAFER_ID, '[^-]+', REGEXP_INSTR(T2.WAFER_ID, '-')) IN (??) AND T3.PRODUCT = :product AND T3.MAPID = :mapid AND T1.TEST_AREA NOT IN ('PARAMETRIC', 'INLINE') AND T2.PROBE_CNT = 0 ORDER BY T2.WAFER_ID

-- Create Date : 2019-08-13 16:18:19 SELECT T1.LOT_SEQ, T1.LOT_ID, T1.LOT_TYPE, T2.WAFER_SEQ, T2.WAFER_ID, T1.TEST_AREA, T1.DEVICE_ALIAS, T1.PROGRAM, T2.PROGRAM_REV, T2.PROBE_CNT FROM TQP_LOT T1, TQP_WAFER T2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACTORY AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T2.END_TIME >= TO_DATE (:dtstart,'YYYYMMDD') AND T2.END_TIME < TO_DATE (:dtend,'YYYYMMDD') AND T1.TEST_AREA IN (??) AND T1.DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND T1.PROGRAM = :program AND T1.LOT_SEQ IN (??) AND T2.PROBE_CNT = 0 ORDER BY T2.WAFER_SEQ
-- Create Date : 2019-09-03 14:20:06 SELECT WAFER_ID || ' (' || PROBE_CNT || ')' WAFER_ID, WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ IN (??) AND PROGRAM = :PROGRAM ORDER BY 1
-- Create Date : 2019-09-03 17:53:54 SELECT PROGRAM FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ IN (??) GROUP BY PROGRAM ORDER BY 1
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET MAP_CFG_SEQ = :cfg_seq WHERE 1 = 1 AND WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET WAFER_ID = :WAFER_ID , PROBE_CNT = :PROBE_CNT WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :WAFER_SEQ
SELECT WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ AND PROGRAM = :PROGRAM ORDER BY 1
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET SCRIBE_LOT = :LOT_ID WHERE LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ
DELETE FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ, PROGRAM = :PROGRAM, PROBE_CNT = :PROBE_CNT WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :WAFER_SEQ

-- Create Date : 2019-09-25 13:16:35 SELECT T1.LOT_SEQ, T1.LOT_ID, T1.LOT_TYPE, T2.WAFER_SEQ, T2.WAFER_ID, T1.TEST_AREA, T1.DEVICE_ALIAS, T2.PROGRAM, T2.PROGRAM_REV, T2.PROBE_CNT FROM TQP_LOT T1, TQP_WAFER T2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.FACTORY = T2.FACTORY AND T1.LOT_SEQ = T2.LOT_SEQ AND T1.TEST_AREA IN (??) AND T1.DEVICE_ALIAS = :device AND T2.PROGRAM = :program AND T1.LOT_SEQ IN (??) AND T2.PROBE_CNT = 0 ORDER BY T2.WAFER_SEQ
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET MAP_CFG_SEQ = :configseq WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET PROBE_CNT = PROBE_CNT + 1 WHERE LOT_SEQ = :LOT_SEQ AND WAFER_ID IN ( SELECT WAFER_ID FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :WAFER_SEQ )
SELECT * FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :WAFER_SEQ
